headline_seed: Rescuers race to free survivors trapped inside train after fatal crash
description_seed: Two trains collided on the outskirts of the Indonesian capital on Monday, killing at least 14 people.

what: Rescuers race to free survivors trapped inside train after fatal crash

clean_source_blocks.text: Two trains collided on the outskirts of the Indonesian capital on Monday, killing at least 14 people.
Rescuers are racing to try and free people trapped inside a train involved in a fatal collision outside the Indonesian capital Jakarta on Monday.
Some people screamed "hysterically" as the trains collided, one passenger told the BBC's Indonesia service. Other eyewitnesses said they saw "many victims" injured in the crash.
In January 2024, several people were killed and dozens more injured when two trains collided in a rice field in Cicalengka.

source_text:
Two trains collided on the outskirts of the Indonesian capital on Monday, killing at least 14 people.

Rescuers are racing to try and free people trapped inside a train involved in a fatal collision outside the Indonesian capital Jakarta on Monday.

Some people screamed "hysterically" as the trains collided, one passenger told the BBC's Indonesia service. Other eyewitnesses said they saw "many victims" injured in the crash.

In January 2024, several people were killed and dozens more injured when two trains collided in a rice field in Cicalengka.
